digest.component_or_area: DC sub-task parent sync / outbound hierarchy reconciliation
propositions: A non-epic parent on a sub-task is suppressed silently by _resolve_local_parent, returning byte-identical (False, None) to the 'unbound, retry later' case, making record_parent_divergence unreachable and causing the pass to exit 0 while hierarchy diverges

DC silently accepts and ignores PUT fields.parent on a sub-task (req-0056/0058), while clearing it with null returns 400 (req-0055/0057), and sub-task editmeta exposes no parent field, making sub-task reparent impossible on the platform

The three failing test cells asserted operations the platform cannot perform (wrong oracles), not symptoms of the rebar defect; re-homing to Epic Link on non-sub-task children with new alert signaling on emit-time suppression resolves all three to green
Emit-time suppression of non-epic parent must record a durable outbound-field-dropped bridge alert instead of silent no-op, completing 39c1 AC4 by making the divergence operator-visible
